channel.title: Changelogs on Myriad
channel.description: Recent content in Changelogs on Myriad

item.description: This version ports the pack to the Chaos Cubed drop, adding a new recipe for cinnabar, new mason trades, and a few other features.

item.title: 1.6.3 Beta 1
item.description: This beta begins the port to Chaos Cubed, adding a new recipe for cinnabar and a few other features.
This version begins the rebrand to Myriad, adds new models for baby snails and sproutlings, and ports to Tiny Takeover.
This version ports to the Mounts of Mayhem drop, while adding a few minor features in the process.

item.title: 1.6.0: Resin and Ruins
item.description: This update adds the creaking crypt, resin pottery, resin candy, as well as reworking the woodland mansion, ancient city archaeology, and much more.

item.title: 1.6.0 Beta 4
item.description: The fourth beta for 1.6, adding a new source of brown dye, changing some of the creaking crypt, and several other changes.

item.title: 1.6.0 Beta 3
item.description: The third beta for 1.6, including a new basement for the creaking crypt and a few other changes.
This version ports to the copper age drop, while also adding a few other minor features.

item.title: 1.6.0 Beta 2
item.description: The second beta for 1.6, tweaking existing content and adding a few new advancements and recipes.

item.title: 1.6.0 Beta 1
item.description: The first beta for 1.6, adding the creaking crypt, resin pottery, a new armor trim, a new banner pattern, and a full rework of the paintbrush and mansion basement.
This update adds enchantable and craftable horse armor, as well as enchanted golden carrot changes and much much more.
This update adds dyed written books, equippable lockets of learning, and updates several textures while porting to 1.21.7.
This update adds dyed compasses and several other small features and changes while porting to the new Chase the Skies drop.
This update ports the pack to the “Spring to Life” drop while adding several small related features.

item.title: 1.5.0: Pots and Plants and Potions
item.description: This version adds tons of new decor options, as well as reworking the cursed crown, gobblerift, and crashed end ship.
This minor version ports the pack to 1.21.2 and adds several minor quality of life features.
